name: glab-guru
description: Expert GitLab guide — glab CLI mastery (mr/issue/ci/job/release/api with -F json/--jq), authoring .gitlab-ci.yml (rules, workflow, needs, artifacts, cache, includes, spec inputs), designing CI/CD pipelines (DAG, parent-child, multi-project, merge trains, environments), CI/CD components and the catalog, and pipeline security hardening (OIDC id_tokens, CI_JOB_TOKEN allowlists, protected branches/environments, masked variables).

interface.shortDescription: glab CLI, .gitlab-ci.yml, and CI/CD pipeline guidance
interface.longDescription: Use GitLab Guru to work with the glab CLI, author and debug .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines (rules, workflow, needs, artifacts, cache, includes, spec inputs), design CI/CD architectures (DAG, parent-child, multi-project, merge trains, environment promotion), build and consume CI/CD components from the catalog, and harden pipeline security (OIDC id_tokens, CI_JOB_TOKEN allowlists, protected branches and environments, masked variables).
defaultPrompt: Use GitLab Guru to write a .gitlab-ci.yml pipeline for this project.
Use GitLab Guru to review this pipeline for security issues.
Use GitLab Guru to debug why my pipeline doesn't run.
